subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A', 'B' and 'C' to write five complete sentences.

Pakistani forces (d) The people who fought because v. he fights for a noble cause against the Pakistani army iv. sacrificed their lives which is the freedom of the (e) Many of the freedom fighters v. fought a glorious War of motherland Independence
guide_solution: Matching (a) A freedom fighter is honoured in all lands and in all times, because he fights for a noble cause which is the freedom of the motherland. (b) The people of Bangladesh fought a glorious War of Independence against the Pakistani occupation forces in 1971. (c) They fought for long nine months and defeated the well-trained Pakistani forces. (d) The people who fought against the Pakistani army and the people who took part in the war are called the freedom fighters. (e) Many of the freedom fighters sacrificed their lives for the cause of the motherland.
